label: BL
reason: User-provided input flows into the cookie name via getName(), which is then used in the cookie value, but there is no explicit encoding or sanitization applied to the cookie value before being added to the response. However, the cookie value is derived from a random number, which might suggest it is not directly user-controlled. Reviewers may reasonably disagree whether this constitutes a real vulnerability.

evidence.note: User-provided input flows into cookie name and value; no explicit encoding observed
